prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet village market at dawn. On the left, an old woman in a blue shawl sits on a wooden crate, her posture slumped in rest. Next to her stands a woven basket overflowing with bright red apples. In the center, a young boy in striped shorts points eagerly toward the fruit, his arm extended straight. Beside him, a spotted cat looks at the boy with wide, curious eyes, its tail twitching slightly. On the right, a farmer in a straw hat hands a single apple to the child, his hand outstretched in generosity. Behind them, a rusty bicycle leans against a stone wall, its wheel slightly bent. There is no sunlight breaking through the clouds.
